concerns.text: FR-002 forbids any synthetic or imputed data ('No synthetic or imputed data may be introduced at this stage'), while FR-003 explicitly requires imputation of the correlation coefficient *r* (median r or fallback r=0.5) for studies lacking it. This direct conflict makes the requirements mutually exclusive.

The document headings refer to "User Scenarios & Testing" but the individual items are labeled "User Story 1", "User Story 2", etc. This unstable terminology may cause confusion when tracing requirements to user narratives.
